thread:
alex_support: Customer reports promo code 'EVENINGSPARK' rejected as "invalid/expired" via API, but shows active in Promo dashboard. Customer says tried on two accounts, screenshot attached.

maria_billing: Seen this one — dashboard shows active until 2026-12-31. Did a manual redeem in dashboard and it works. API returns 410 with body: {"error":"promo_invalid_signature","code":410}.

promo-bot: Automated scan: code exists in DB (id=p_7832), campaign=summer_partner, signer_version=v2. Last signer rotation: 2026-02-11T02:14:09Z.

sam_ops: Quick hypothesis: we rotated the promo signing key (v2) and some replicas still validating against v1, or the redemption service didn't pick up new key. Can you paste full API request/headers?

alex_support: Request from customer (redacted):

POST /v1/promos/redeem
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
{"code":"EVENINGSPARK", "account_email":"user+trial@example.com"}

Response:
{"status":410, "error":"promo_invalid_signature", "detail":"signature mismatch for signer v2"}

jess_eng: Repro steps I ran from staging: created promo signed with v1 keys, rotated signer to v2, redeems fail until cache TTL expires (5m) on redemption service. Looks like rotation invalidates previously issued signed tokens but some redemption workers keep cached verification keys.

sam_ops: Which service owns the key caching? redemption-api or promo-auth?

jess_eng: redemption-api caches keys for performance (edge verification). There was a recent change to increase cache TTL to 300s to reduce KMS calls. That interacts poorly with immediate rotation.

maria_billing: Customer expects immediate use; they're asking for trial credits if we can't fix quickly. Can we do an emergency manual redeem and issue credits?

jess_eng: Manual redeem via dashboard already worked for our test account. For API customers we can run a migration to flush redemption-api key cache across pods. I'll push a small change to invalidate local caches on rotation webhook. Need ops help to roll the flush now.

sam_ops: I can trigger a rolling cache flush. Plan: post a message to /ops with command to hit /internal/keys/refresh on all redemption-api pods. I'll run that now.

sam_ops: DONE — triggered refresh across 6 pods, 1 failed and auto-retried. Please ask customer to retry in ~30s.

alex_support: Reached out to customer: they retried and redeem succeeded. They requested an apology credit for the friction.

maria_billing: I'll grant a one-time $50 trial credit and log the invoice note. Code: manual_credit_2003456789.

jess_eng: Follow-up: created issue to reduce TTL impact and add proactive cache-invalidate on key rotation webhook (GH #4521). Also adding an alert when signer rotation occurs without successful cache invalidation across services.

sam_ops: Adding runbook step to cache-flush on rotations.

alex_support: Closing this thread with customer notified, credit issued, fix queued. :white_check_mark:
